summary: Added casino house games (Limbo, Mines, Plinko, Keno). Backend: 12 pytest cases cover auth gating, stake deduction, payout crediting, insufficient balance, invalid config, mines start/reveal/cashout, keno pick limits, limbo target bounds, plus sportsbook regression -- 12/12 passed. Frontend e2e via Playwright: logged in with admin, Casino lobby shows 4 cards, each game routes correctly, Limbo (stake 5 USDT target 2 -> result 2.39x won, balance updated), Plinko (3 USDT medium/16 rows, hit 1x bucket - net zero but mechanics correct), Keno (auto picks 8, stake 2 USDT -> payout 5 USDT, bal 2594.25->2597.25), Mines (3 mines, stake 2 USDT, start deducts, safe reveal at 1.13x, cashout credits 2.25 USDT), sportsbook regression (nav-sports returns, odds-grid visible), and logged-out limbo-play-button opens auth modal.

issues: Header shows balance in USD aggregate ($10,764) so a round-trip Plinko 1x hit leaves header unchanged -- misleading; per-coin balance inside BetControls (Bal: 2,594.25 USDT) updates correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~800 lines; consider splitting casino section into a casino router module for maintainability.

Casino routes use random.random/sample (not cryptographic). Marketed as 'provably fair' in UI but no seed/hash commitment is exposed to the client -- consider adding server/client seed + hash chain if you want to live up to that claim.

mines/start abandons any prior active game BUT the prior stake remains deducted (comment acknowledges this). Starting a new game while one is active silently forfeits previous stake -- consider returning the prior game-id or refunding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Casino house games verified end-to-end with real stake/payout flow against the live backend. Mines flow is probabilistic -- for retests, loop reveals/restarts to find a safe tile (3 mines => ~88% chance per tile). Keno 'keno-drawn' testid wasn't located in DOM; non-blocking since mechanics verified via balance delta and sel count. Plinko can land on sub-1x -- do not assert >0 payout.
